data.one_liner: Create heart and star shaped favorite buttons with built-in animation effects.
data.what_it_does: favorite_button provides pre-styled heart and star interactive widgets that trigger animations when toggled. It exposes a valueChanged callback to track the current favorite or starred state.
use_when: You need a quick heart or star favorite button with animations.
You want a drop-in button widget for bookmarking or favoriting items.
avoid_when: You need completely custom shape morphing beyond hearts and stars.
You are building a complex animation system requiring Rive or advanced custom physics.
strengths: Easy to use with minimal boilerplate
Includes default animations for heart and star shapes
weaknesses: Limited shape selection (heart and star only)
Very basic feature set with no advanced customization documented
